entries.title: Point at parts of a card and send your comments together
entries.body: Select words, or use Point at to pick a part of a card. Queue it as-is or add a comment, then send several notes together with Chat. Your notes stay linked to the words or parts you picked.

picture.alt: A card’s thread shows two queued notes, one with a comment, an unsent count below the reply field, and a cursor icon outside its left edge
